findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_brandable_domains, check_domain_availability, generate_domain_names, screen_trademark_conflicts, get_checkout_link, get_ai_tokens_pay_link, get_domain_register_pay_link, get_domain_purchase_pay_link, get_domain_register_pay_link_guest, get_domain_purchase_pay_link_guest · Private data: get_domain_details, screen_trademark_conflicts, get_checkout_link, register_domain_spt, buy_ai_tokens, get_ai_tokens_pay_link, get_domain_register_pay_link_guest, get_domain_purchase_pay_link_guest, create_registrant_contact · Public sink: get_domain_register_pay_link_guest, get_domain_purchase_pay_link_guest, create_registrant_contact · Destructive: screen_trademark_conflicts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_brandable_domains, check_domain_availability, generate_domain_names, screen_trademark_conflicts, get_checkout_link, get_ai_tokens_pay_link, get_domain_register_pay_link, get_domain_purchase_pay_link, get_domain_register_pay_link_guest, get_domain_purchase_pay_link_guest · Private data: get_domain_details, screen_trademark_conflicts, get_checkout_link, register_domain_spt, buy_ai_tokens, get_ai_tokens_pay_link, get_domain_register_pay_link_guest, get_domain_purchase_pay_link_guest, create_registrant_contact · Public sink: get_domain_register_pay_link_guest, get_domain_purchase_pay_link_guest, create_registrant_contact · Destructive: screen_trademark_conflicts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
